title: Need help?
intro: You are not alone. These people help children every day. Calling is free.
urgent: If someone is in danger right now, call 112.

helplines.name: Child Helpline
helplines.when: If you or another child needs help, care or protection. Adults can call for a child too.
helplines.hours: Free. Day and night, every day.

sources.title: PIB, Ministry of Women and Child Development: integration of Child Helpline with ERSS-112 (2023)

helplines.name: Emergency
helplines.when: If someone is hurt or in danger right now. Police, fire and ambulance.
helplines.hours: Free. Day and night, every day.

sources.title: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS), Government of India

helplines.name: Tele-MANAS
helplines.when: If you feel very sad, scared or worried, and want to talk to someone kind.
helplines.hours: Free. Day and night. You can choose your language.

sources.title: Tele-MANAS, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare: Tele-MANAS launch (2022)

helplines.name: Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.when: If someone tricks your family out of money online. Other online harm can be reported at cybercrime.gov.in.

sources.title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, Ministry of Home Affairs
PIB, Ministry of Home Affairs: Curbing Cyber Frauds in Digital India

trustedAdult.title: How to tell a trusted adult
steps: Think of an adult you trust. It could be a parent, grandparent, teacher, aunt, uncle or neighbour.
Find a quiet moment. You can say: "I need to tell you something important."
Say what happened in your own words. You do not need to know every detail.
If they do not listen, or do not help, tell another adult you trust. Keep telling until someone helps.
Asking for help is brave. It is never your fault.

rights.title: Your rights
items: You have the right to go to school and learn.
You have the right to be safe at home, at school, outside and online.
You have the right to rest and play, and not to do work that keeps you from school.
You have the right to finish growing up before anyone can marry you.
You have the right to be listened to and to ask for help.

disclaimer: Saksham is a game for learning. It cannot call anyone or read any messages. This page gives general information, not legal advice.
